Product Focus
Instead,
Africa Health Supplies
focuses on institutional clinical, neonatal, and maternal care hardware for medical facilities. Their inventory includes:
Neonatal intensive care and jaundice management devices (e.g., phototherapy machines)
Respiratory support hardware (e.g., CPAP systems)
Standard clinical diagnostic and monitoring tools (e.g., fetal dopplers and blood pressure monitors)
Hospital sterilization equipment (e.g., autoclaves)

Africa Health Supplies
provides clinical-grade hardware such as multi-parameter
Patient Monitors
for real-time tracking. While consumer tech features smartwatches, wearable ECGs, and sleep trackers,
professional remote patient monitoring intersects with specialized tools like continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) for managing chronic care needs
Clinical vs. Consumer Health Tech
Remote Patient Monitors:
Hospital-grade bedside or portable units that continuously stream vitals like ECG, blood pressure, and oxygen saturation to care teams.
Continuous Glucose Monitors:
Specialized biosensors (such as Abbott or Dexcom systems) tracking interstitial fluid glucose levels 24/7.

Smartwatches & Wearables:
Consumer-facing wristbands that measure opportunistic heart rate, basic sleep patterns, and single-lead ECG snapshots.

Key Tracking Parameters
Metabolic:
Interstitial glucose trends and alarms for highs and lows.
Cardiovascular:
Real-time heart rhythm analysis, pulse rate, and SpO2.
Rest & Recovery:
Automated movement analysis and sleep stage scoring.
